rationale: Revised plan addresses three feedback findings from attempt 2. denial_code_ranking now uses scope=denied_claims to compute frequency shares among denied claims only, ensuring shares sum to 1.0 and accurately represent each code's proportion of denials (fixing T4-code_ranking and T4-code_scope feedback). Report now includes small_groups caveat to alert readers that segment rates with fewer than min_group_size (30) claims lack statistical stability and should be interpreted cautiously (fixing T4-caveat_small_groups feedback). All other parameters remain unchanged: denial_rate_by_segment continues segmenting by all five task-specified dimensions with adjudicated_claims denominator; report includes synthetic_data and sample_preview caveats per T1 feedback; show_denominators=true displays numerator/denominator pairs as required by T2 feedback.
changes_summary: Changed denial_code_ranking scope from 'all_claims' to 'denied_claims' so code frequency shares sum to 1.0 and represent each code's proportion of denied claims. Added 'small_groups' caveat to report to alert readers that rates for segments with fewer than 30 claims are statistically unstable.
